expected.note: Mirror of the S6 stale-slot case, and the commonest real shape: one iDevice per page, both fully correct. The producer's lmsData map is keyed by the PAGE-LOCAL slot, so page 1's objB1 overwrites page 0's objA1 in slot 1 and the emitted suspend_data string is byte-identical apart from the title. Both learners' answers are real and both must be graded 100%. A tracker that decides 'changed' by comparing the slot against its previous occupant sees no change and silently drops objB1's grade.
